tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, inputs — everything that sits on top of the page background.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. A warm “paper” tint so photos don't get lost on pure white.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Hover on rows and tiles, recessed areas, background of “neutral” statuses.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Pressed state, progress bar track, third avatar color.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Thin dividers and card borders. Not for control borders — use border-strong for those.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of outlined buttons, inputs, chips: at least 3:1 contrast against surface-000 and surface-100 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-000, surface-100, surface-200. Toast background (inverse).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, file sizes, captions. At least 4.5:1 on surface-000/100/200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels. Only on surface-000 and surface-100 (≈4.6:1 or higher).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The screen's primary action, selection, links and text buttons on surface-000/100. Text on top — on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand-filled elements.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and selection fills.

tokens.name: brand-container
tokens.usage: Tonal buttons, selected segment, admin role badge, first avatar color. Text on top — on-brand-container.

tokens.name: on-brand-container
tokens.usage: Text on brand-container.

tokens.name: brand-inverse
tokens.usage: Action button inside a toast (on an ink fill): “Undo”.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm accent: the “favorite” star, memory markers. Not for small text (≈3.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: accent-container
tokens.usage: Soft warm background: second avatar color, “anniversary” highlight. Text on top — on-accent-container.

tokens.name: on-accent-container
tokens.usage: Text on accent-container.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Icon and text for “uploaded”, “document valid” on surface-000/100.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Background of the “done” status. Text on top — on-success-container.

tokens.name: on-success-container
tokens.usage: Text on success-container.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Icon and text for “expiring”, “duplicate” on surface-000/100.

tokens.name: warning-container
tokens.usage: Background of a warning status. Text on top — on-warning-container.

tokens.name: on-warning-container
tokens.usage: Text on warning-container.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Upload errors, “expired”, irreversible actions. Text on the fill — on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: danger-container
tokens.usage: Background of an error status and error toast. Text on top — on-danger-container.

tokens.name: on-danger-container
tokens.usage: Text on danger-container.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Border and check mark of a selected photo tile.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: focus-ring-width, 2px offset.

tokens.name: media-placeholder
tokens.usage: Tile background while the preview loads, and for “processing” tiles.

tokens.name: viewer-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the full-screen photo viewer in both themes — photos are viewed on dark.

tokens.name: on-viewer
tokens.usage: Text and icons on viewer-bg and scrim.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming behind a dialog; backing of the video duration badge on a tile (text on-viewer).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page title: album name, person's name.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Date group heading in the timeline, card title.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: File names, people's names, key values in a row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Text of buttons, tabs, menu items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata: date, size, video duration. Only in ink-muted or stronger.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Hashes, IDs, 2FA recovery codes. Never for regular text.

spacing.note: 4px scale. Spacing between page blocks is the same in both modes; component padding in large mode is one step larger (see README, “Size modes”).

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Gap between photo tiles in the timeline.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon and text inside a button, gap inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between adjacent buttons, between row elements in compact mode.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons and rows in compact mode; card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page and panel padding; between cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons and rows in large mode.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a date group heading, around an empty state.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large vertical gaps: empty state, sign-in page.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Photo tiles, thumbnails, role badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, toggles, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Document cards, menus, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, person chips, icon buttons, pill statuses.

size.note: Element sizes in both modes. Compact is the default; users turn on large in settings. On touch screens the hit area is at least hit-target-touch in any mode.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs, toggles in compact mode (Material density -3).

tokens.name: control-height-large
tokens.usage: Control height in large mode.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: List row: member, queued file, menu item — compact mode.

tokens.name: row-height-large
tokens.usage: List row in large mode.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and rows, compact mode.

tokens.name: icon-size-large
tokens.usage: Icons in large mode.

tokens.name: tile-size
tokens.usage: Tile row height in the timeline, compact mode.

tokens.name: tile-size-large
tokens.usage: Tile row height in large mode.

tokens.name: hit-target-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch screens (pointer: coarse), even in compact mode.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Thickness of the focus-ring.

shadow.note: Shadows only for what floats above the page: menus, toasts, dialogs. Cards on the page use a border, no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Dragged tile, raised button.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus and dropdowns.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and toasts.
